captainCorrection.what: The lane returned its row as a bare JSON array. The dispatch generator reads lane returns by shape and requires a top-level object whose rows array carries the rows, so the return was invisible to the state machine and the family stayed FAIL_REPAIR_REQUIRED with a reissued grant. The row itself is unchanged byte for byte; it is now carried under rows. The lane also named the repaired obligations under repairedObligationNames; the generator's structured key is obligationsRepaired, so that key is added with the same single value and the lane's own key is kept.

rows.whatChanged: ONE CONSTANT IN ONE FILE. In scripts/build-census-v1-tx_nd_dwi_deferred-set.mjs the frozen ROUTE object carried routeKeys[0] and primaryRouteKey as "obligation:track-pathway:TX:tx_nd_dwi_deferred:first-offense-dwi-nondisclosure"; both are now "obligation:track-only:TX:tx_nd_dwi_deferred". That is the only edit to the builder, and it is the census key rather than a key this lane chose. THIS LANE READ THE RECORDS RATHER THAN TAKING VF02'S WORD: data/rcap-grade-a/route-obligation-census-v1/category-a-implementation-waves.json carries exactly one obligation key for this family and it is obligation:track-only:TX:tx_nd_dwi_deferred; data/rcap-grade-a/route-obligation-census-v1/identity-resolution/batch-2/resolved.json carries the same one key and no other; source-custody-reconciliation.json and source-queue-reconciliation.json carry the family by worklistGroupId "tx_nd_dwi_deferred-set" and name no route key at all, so they contradict nothing; src/lib/legal-authority/routes/route-splits.json does not mention tx_nd_dwi_deferred in any form (0 occurrences). The family's own product-wiring.json, which is generated from the census, already declared routeKey and routeKeys[0] as obligation:track-only:TX:tx_nd_dwi_deferred and binding.routeKeys the same. So the printed key is now the census key because exactly one key exists across every census record that names one, and it is the key product-wiring.json already carried; nothing here is a choice between two candidates and nothing new was invented. The printed suffix that was removed, first-offense-dwi-nondisclosure, is the DWI-probation sibling's pathway suffix: scripts/build-census-v1-tx_nd_dwi_probation-set.mjs carries obligation:track-pathway:TX:tx_nd_dwi_probation:first-offense-dwi-nondisclosure at the same two lines of its own ROUTE object, which is what a copied builder looks like. The sibling's key is left untouched. AFTER THE EDIT THE FAMILY WAS REBUILT AND EVERY OUTPUT THAT CARRIES THE KEY NOW AGREES WITH product-wiring.json: source-receipt.json routeKeys, production-field-map.json (6 occurrences), participant-instructions.md line 221, and the two composed pages. The "Route:" line stayed exactly where the siblings keep it - page 9 line 40 and page 24 line 17 of the pdftotext -layout extraction, unmoved - and a page-by-page text diff of all 24 pages of both fixtures shows that one line and nothing else. No legal text, no write position, no field census row and no protected field was touched: field-census.census-v1.json, build-findings.json, approval-request.json, build-status.json and reports/actual-writes.json are byte-identical across the repair.
